artifact_inventory.candidate_metrics.csv: matched cutoff posterior metrics for full and supported_ypp_observed populations
artifact_inventory.disagreement_games.csv: real margin/YPP disagreement cases and local effects
artifact_inventory.future_game_metrics.csv: frozen V1 future-margin scoring from each posterior
artifact_inventory.pairing_contamination.csv: same-cutoff Y2-supported minus original all-pairings diagnostic differences
artifact_inventory.plots/: deterministic coverage, signal, and final-rank delta PNGs
artifact_inventory.summary.json: machine-readable configuration, audit, metrics, and recommendation
artifact_inventory.team_impact.csv: FBS posterior expected-rank shifts from removing unsupported FCS-FCS YPP

candidate_family.fit: weighted pseudo-observations with equal total weight per game and robust Student-t IRLS
candidate_family.margin_basis: intercept, signed margin/20, abs(margin)/20, fixed hinges at -28,-14,0,14,28, plus V1 site indicators
candidate_family.naive_independent_diagnostic: p(margin | ranks, site) × p(YPP_diff | ranks, site), never a promotion candidate
candidate_family.rank_basis: same-subdivision odd percentile terms d, d*mean, d*abs(d); cross-subdivision FBS-minus-FCS d and d*mean
candidate_family.y0: frozen Historical Likelihood V1 margin factor
candidate_family.y1: p(YPP_diff | margin basis, site, supported pairing), rank-independent semantic null
candidate_family.y2_all_pairings_original: retained diagnostic p(YPP_diff | margin basis, restrained rank-percentile basis, site, all pairings); invalid for promotion
candidate_family.y2_supported: corrected p(YPP_diff | margin basis, restrained rank-percentile basis, site, FBS-FBS/FBS-FCS only)

data_split.final_rank_target: frozen final constituent-rank PMFs from team_season_rank_distributions.csv; common FBS keys only
data_split.final_test: 2022-2025 untouched until candidate fitting, df selection, and promotion selection were complete

evaluation.posterior_engine: production V1 BP semantics with research factor multiplication; unsupported FCS-FCS YPP uses an all-ones factor; 100 iterations, tolerance 1e-6, damping .35

frozen_production_integrity.scope: Historical Likelihood V1, Posterior V1, H 1.1, C 1.2, Performance V1, weekly publication, website

population_views.full: all eligible regular-season FBS-FBS, FBS-FCS, and FCS-FCS games through each cutoff; unsupported FCS-FCS YPP still uses the exact V1 margin fallback
population_views.supported_ypp_observed: eligible games through the final cutoff with usable YPP and pairing exactly FBS-FBS or FBS-FCS; FCS-FCS is excluded even when YPP exists; V1 and Y2 use identical game keys

research_question: Does YPP add enough quality information beyond margin to deserve a place in the game likelihood?
